title: Holiday Gnome
text: Holiday Gnome. I am Finnish and so to me, this is a tonntu.. others call them tomte (Swed) or nisse (Norway)... very Scandinavian.  They are happy little guys that like to protect your home... however, be careful to treat them with love or they can become mischievous!  This guy is tall and very gnome like... his beard is white.. his hat is wired so you can position as you like and he easily stands.  He is just what I expected and I am so happy!
